identity.title: [v0.92.1][Sidecar] Harden and retain the AWS GPU Shepherd proof runner

values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Execute positive and negative runner fixtures for parsing, account/IAM/security-group/artifact validation, lock ownership, exact revision, interruption, deadline, cleanup, and redaction without AWS mutation.
lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned executable fixture is an explicit implementation deliverable; readiness fails closed until this exact target exists and passes.

lanes.proof_role: Verify the approved business-account and all pre-provisioned launch predicates without acquiring a lock or launching compute.
lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned runner is an explicit implementation deliverable; no AWS readback or mutation is authorized until this exact target exists and passes deterministic review.

lanes.proof_role: Run one exact-revision, real-model, GPU-resident Shepherd proof and prove owner-bound cleanup and bounded cost.
lanes.defer_reason: Requires separate operator authorization naming the exact reviewed revision, one run ID, deadline, and maximum cost after read-only preflight and launch-readiness review pass.

lanes.proof_role: Reject whitespace defects in the exact issue change.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed before paid mutation on any account, authorization, cost, deadline, lock, IAM, no-ingress, artifact, quota, reaper, exact-revision, model-proof, redaction, or cleanup ambiguity; preserve bounded diagnostics and require a fresh reviewed attempt rather than fallback or retry.
